title: Rav Nachman bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Shmuel in [Eruvin 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.34b.16). Hyman also cites 80b. [Eruvin 102](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.102a.10) has Nachumi bar Ada, as does [Beitzah 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.31b.7): Rav Nachumi bar Ada.
In [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.2.4.7), R’ Yonah reports a teaching by Rav Nachman bar Ada.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The locators לד: פ: mean Eruvin 34b and 80b; קב, gives 102 without a definite folio side. These are Hyman’s references.
Hyman gives Nachman in the heading and Nachumi in the Eruvin 102/Beitzah 31b passages. The alternative name form is preserved without resolving a historical identity.
Yonah’s abbreviated title is rendered R'; the full רב before Nachman is rendered Rav.

[Eruvin 34b:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.34b.16) and [Beitzah 31b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.31b.7) give the same explanation in Shmuel’s name with different transmitter names. [Eruvin 102a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.102a.10) gives Nachumi bar Ada in a separate discussion of a bolt. Hyman gives 102 without a folio side; the 80b reference is still unresolved.
